title: CommandProfile
description: A named, argv-fixed command declared by a repository (ADR-0005 §5). workspace.run_profile(profileId, parameters) is the only route to command execution: there is no tool that accepts a shell string or a free-form argv array from a model. Parameters are substituted as discrete argv elements, never concatenated into a shell, and no shell is involved at any layer.

schemaVersion.description: ADR-0024 §5: stored documents are versioned as data. One version exists in V1.

argv.description: Fixed argument vector. Elements of the form ${paramName} are replaced by the validated value of that parameter as a single discrete argv element.

parameters.description: Declared, typed and schema-validated. An undeclared parameter is rejected.

pattern.description: For string parameters. Should be as narrow as the use allows; this is the last line of defence on values that ultimately reach a process.

cwdScope.description: Workspace-relative paths where this profile may run.

sideEffectClass.description: Command execution is confined to the granted workspace and is reversible by workspace rebuild (ADR-0003 §6). A profile cannot declare a higher class; external writes go through integration tools, which are separately audited and idempotency-keyed.
